question: Is there some reason that this is Otto's birthday?
answer: When I was deciding the character's birthday, I took the sound of "Hard work (leaves a mark) on you" (note: The Japanese pronunciation in parentheses matches uncommon pronunciations for 3, 2, and 4.) and made it March 24th. Incidentally, his ground-dragon buddy Verhoe is September 6th (note: similarly, the pronunciation for 9 and 6 is similar to the sound of the term used here for hard work) so together they're the "Hard work leaves a mark on you" combo.
